name: bryan-s-blog
description: Bryan Chen's Hugo blog, ready for Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build:cf: curl -L -o hugo.tar.gz https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.157.0/hugo_extended_withdeploy_0.157.0_linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar -xzf hugo.tar.gz && chmod +x ./hugo && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/CaiJimmy/hugo-theme-stack.git themes/hugo-theme-stack && ./hugo --theme hugo-theme-stack -b "${CF_PAGES_URL:-https://example.pages.dev}"

author: Bryan Chen
